questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

On another day I was

A: demanded to see my ticket

B: ticket-checking personnel

C: travelling in the train when the
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** CBA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Part C is the first part*** as it is a direct continuation of the phrase "On another day I was" as it focusses on what I was doing
 
• *Parts B and A follows C as they deal with what happened when I was travelling.** B introduces the 'ticket-checking personnel' and C describes what he did. ***

Hence the correct order is **CBA.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

**For any general statement(sentence), the order is always Subject-Verb-Object.**

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'no improvement'.**

In the post-liberalisation era, urbanisation (has being taking) place at a rapid pace.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **has taken.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

The helping verbs 'has', 'have' and 'had' take V3 with them. 

So, options 2 & 3 are eliminated at the outset.

We can see that the event is one that has happened in the recent past and hence would take the present perfect tense. *It is the form of the verb used __for actions or events that have been completed or have happened in a period of time up to now.__*

Thus, **option 1 **is the correct answer.

__**Correct Sentence:**__ *In the post-liberalisation era, urbanisation __**has taken**__ place at a rapid pace.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__**Present perfect**__: The **present perfect** is used to indicate a link between the **present** and the past. The time of the action is before now but not specified, and we are often more interested in the result than in the action itself.

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

The youngsters lined the cafe.

options.text: The cafe is lined by the youngsters.
The cafe was lined by the youngsters.
The cafe lined by the youngsters.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** ****The cafe was lined by the youngsters.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

The given sentence is in the active voice with a verb in the simple past tense.

When we convert such a sentence from the active to the passive voice:

__
 
• *The **subject and object of the active voice** become the **object and subject of the passive voice respectively.***
 
• The ***past participle**** is used along with**** 'by'. ***
 
• The rest of the sentence does not undergo any change. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Structure for the changed sentence**: __*Object+Past participle+by+subject*__

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Over population of humans is

P : the biggest factor behind so

Q : many social, sustainable and environmental

R : issues all over the world
questions.solution:
The correct answer** **is** PQR.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A sentence does not end with a connector **so **or adjective **environmental. **

 
 
• Thus, options 1 & 3 are incorrect.
 
 
 
• In option 2, the sequence QP is wrong, because an adjective is followed by a noun, but here we have an article in place of an adjective.
 
 
• So, option 2 is incorrect.
 
 

Thus, **option 4 i.e. PQR **is the correct answer.

He asked him to ______ some documents.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** go through.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Go through: **search through or examine something, especially methodically

 
 
• Example: *The deal** went through** as agreed.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The explanations of the other words and phrases:-

• Example:* If you don't know what the word means,** look **it** up** in a dictionary.*
 
 
 
• **Imagine: **form a mental image or concept of
 
 
• Example: *I can't **imagine** what he wants from us.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

This question tests your concept and knowledge of phrasal verbs.

A phrasal verb** is a combination of words (a **verb** + a preposition or **verb** +adverb) that when used together, usually take on a different meaning to that of the original **verb**. 

For eg. Run into, Pick up, Turn on, etc.

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select "No Error".**

A balanced diet is one that provide (1)/ an adequate intake of energy and nutrients (2)/ for the maintenance of the body and good health. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

Here, the concept of subject-verb agreement is touched upon.

Since 'a balanced diet' is a singular subject, a singular verb should follow it.

Thus, we need to replace **provide **with **provides to make the sentence correct. **

Hence, option 1 is the correct answer. 

The correct sentence: *A balanced diet is one that **provides **an adequate intake of energy and nutrients for the maintenance of the body and good health.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select "No Error".**

When we respect (1)/ everyone’s spiritual identity, (2)/ we promote peace and happiness to all. (3)/No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'we promote peace and happiness** to** all.' 
 
• Here, the **concept of the preposition** has been touched upon. 
 
• The **correct preposition **to follow the **verb 'promote' would be 'among'**.
 
 
• E.g.- The conquered territories were portioned out** among** the victors.
 
 

**Correct sentence:__*** 'When we respect everyone’s spiritual identity, we promote peace and happiness **among **all.' *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

 From the word 'all' in the sentence, we can gauge that the correct preposition would be 'among'.
